trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned; nothing extra is asked of you beyond finishing the ledger below.

steps.t: Work the six-stage roadmap in order so no counted trophy is left for a second run.
Keep one manual save at every chapter boundary as insurance.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
Track every counted trophy with the YOUR COUNT counter in this app.
Leave cheats off for the whole run; they disable trophies and saving.
When the 54th other trophy pops, this platinum follows automatically.
Check the audit strip: 55 official trophies and 1,350 PSN points in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission; it teaches movement, driving and the first Leonida Keys beats and cannot be skipped.

steps.t: Start a new game and follow the opening prompts through the first drive.
Stay with the mission markers; no optional content is required here.
Complete the fishing sequence exactly as the prompts direct.
Let the closing cutscene play out to register the completion.
Confirm the bronze pops before moving into free roam.
Make your first manual save right after the mission ends.
Head for Jason's house next; Chapter 1 content opens from there.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission in order; before the chapter closes, clear the balcony meditation and Shirley's errands at Jason's house.

steps.t: Follow the chapter's mission markers from Jason's house outward.
After Down to Earth, meditate on the balcony at Jason's house.
Run Shirley's two errands while they are still offered.
Pick up the house magazines before the chapter ends.
Meet Kenton and start his diving line when it appears.
Begin scanning vehicles whenever a new model passes you.
Finish the final Chapter 1 mission to pop the bronze.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; Coffee Break unlocks duo play here, which the partner trophies and the last meditation spot depend on later.

steps.t: Play the chapter missions in the order the map offers them.
Complete Coffee Break to unlock switching between the pair.
Start the jewelry jobs and the Key Cloner line as they appear.
Register your first vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
Open the character questlines that arrive this chapter.
Keep chapter-boundary manual saves before big set pieces.
Clear the last Chapter 2 mission to earn the bronze.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 as Vice City fully opens; most systems, shops and side lines are live by the end of this chapter.

steps.t: Work the Chapter 3 mission chain without leaving set pieces early.
Spend shop money as you go toward the $100,000 spending total.
Keep discovering vehicles; the 100-vehicle counter runs all game.
Push stranger strands forward whenever their markers appear.
Bank laundered marked bills through contacts when offered.
Save manually at the chapter's final mission marker.
Complete the closing mission to pop the bronze.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the climb into the endgame; bank vaults and the heaviest set pieces unlock across this chapter.

steps.t: Follow the Chapter 4 chain in order from the first marker.
Use the cafe mission line to unlock bank vault access.
Rob your first bank vault cleanly once vaults are open.
Keep counted collectibles moving between story missions.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile; it slows every later grind.
Save before the chapter finale in case a set piece fails.
Finish the final Chapter 4 mission for the bronze.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the story gold; free roam continues afterwards and every trophy quest giver returns, so nothing else locks here.

steps.t: Enter the final mission with full health, armour and ammo.
Keep a manual save from just before the mission marker.
Play the finale through without skipping its closing scenes.
Let the credits finish; the gold registers at completion.
Confirm free roam resumes after the credits roll.
Return to any quest giver left open; they are all back.
Open the 100% checklist in Progress, Stats, to start Stage 4.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Breakfast Run when its marker appears in the story flow; it is a straight story beat with no side conditions.

steps.t: Accept Breakfast Run when the marker appears on the map.
Follow the route prompts and stay in the mission vehicle.
Complete the delivery leg without abandoning the objective.
Ride out the closing scene until control returns to you.
Check the bronze has registered in the checklist.
Save manually once the mission is marked complete.
Return to the main chapter chain from the same area.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, the chapter's big set piece; approach prep is fixed by the story, so just play the plan through.

steps.t: Start The Cartel Heist from its story marker when offered.
Complete each prep beat the mission assigns to the pair.
Stick to the heist plan during the entry sequence.
Cover your partner through the vault and escape legs.
Lose the heat fully before the mission will close out.
Let the payout scene finish to register completion.
Bank the proceeds; they feed the spending and laundering totals.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Child's Play in the story flow; a self-contained beat with no collectible or count attached.

steps.t: Take Child's Play when its marker joins the chapter chain.
Follow the escort prompts and keep the objective in sight.
Clear the confrontation the mission stages for you.
Finish the drive home leg without leaving the vehicle behind.
Watch the closing scene through to control returning.
Verify the bronze in the trophy checklist afterwards.
Save at the nearest safehouse before continuing the chain.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners when it appears; the mission name is stylised DWNFALL on the trophy, Headliners in the mission log.

steps.t: Accept Headliners from its story marker in the chain.
Work the venue sequence in the order the prompts give.
Protect your partner during the headline set piece.
Escape the area and drop the wanted level fully.
Return to the marker to close the mission out.
Confirm DWNFALL shows earned in the checklist.
Make a fresh manual save before the next chapter beat.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown at the airport authority; this mission also sets up the unscheduled-departure trophy at the same location.

steps.t: Start VCIA Takedown when the story sends you to VCIA.
Follow the takedown plan through the terminal sequence.
Keep the objective vehicle intact during the chase leg.
Clear the runway confrontation the mission stages.
Leave the airport area and lose the heat to close it.
Check Hi-Jacked has popped in the checklist.
Note VCIA on your map; you return here for a one-off trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a long set piece; stock up before starting because the mission locks your loadout once under way.

steps.t: Buy armour and snacks before taking the mission marker.
Start Operation Savage Glory and follow the assault plan.
Use Combat Focus for clustered enemies inside the compound.
Hold the extraction point until the pickup arrives.
Escape and fully lose the wanted level to finish.
Let the debrief scene end so completion registers.
Restock and save; the chapter chain continues from here.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist in Progress, Stats: story, all robberies, range golds, races, discoveries and the counted collections, at the checklist's own thresholds.

steps.t: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work from that list only.
Finish the story first; the checklist appears in full after it.
Clear every robbery type the checklist names, gang operations included.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges for the range line.
Log the underwater discoveries; the checklist counts 33 of them.
Work challenges to the checklist threshold, not the trophy's 50.
When the readout hits 100%, the gold pops on its own.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts in any vehicles anywhere in Leonida; use the YOUR COUNT counter and farm stunt jumps in batches between missions. The 100% checklist separately asks for 300.

steps.t: Take any ramp or jump at speed and land cleanly on wheels.
Watch the stunt banner; only landed stunts advance the count.
Chain jumps along the Keys causeways for fast batches.
Switch vehicle classes; bikes forgive sloppy landings best.
Log progress in the YOUR COUNT counter after each session.
Keep going past 250 only if you want the checklist's 300.
At 250 landed stunts the silver registers automatically.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: races, ranges, fishing, arcade, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and stunt work each count a type the first time you start one.

steps.t: Start one street race from any race marker on the map.
Enter one Shooting Range challenge, win or lose.
Cast once in any fishing spot to log the fishing type.
Play one arcade cabinet and one drone race start.
Meditate once, hunt once and bowl one frame.
Pull one stunt jump to log the final activity type.
The ninth distinct type tried pops the bronze.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges; learn each range's target pattern at bronze pace first, then chase the gold score with the range's own weapons.

steps.t: Clear each challenge once to learn its target order.
Replay immediately while the pattern is fresh in memory.
Prioritise accuracy chains over raw speed for score.
Use the counter here: 42 golds, no partial credit carries.
Rest between ranges; fatigue wrecks late-session aim.
Gold the indoor ranges last if outdoor ones come easier.
The 42nd gold medal pops the silver at the results screen.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; a win at each distinct course is what counts, not total race wins.

steps.t: Find a Top Fun start point and enter with the stock drone.
Fly the gate order cleanly once before racing for the win.
Race again immediately; rivals keep the same lines.
Mark each won location in the YOUR COUNT counter: 14 total.
Cut corners inside gates; only the gate pass registers.
Save the beach courses for last if wind gives you trouble.
Winning the 14th distinct location pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeat wins on one course do not advance it, so tour the map's race markers and win each once.

steps.t: Pick any race marker and win it once, cleanly.
Move to a new marker; the counter needs different races.
Bring a tuned vehicle for the car classes you struggle with.
Use the YOUR COUNT counter to track distinct wins to 20.
Boat and air races count the same as street races.
Avoid restarts that void the win at the results screen.
The 20th distinct race win pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge; accept it at his spot, then land the heavier scoring catch inside the challenge window.

steps.t: Find Cal at his fishing spot and accept the challenge.
Cast toward the marked water where the challenge fish run.
Work the reel prompts steadily; snapped lines score nothing.
Keep every legal catch; the challenge scores total weight.
Save your best cast for the final minute of the window.
Weigh in ahead of Cal when the timer ends.
Beating his total pops the bronze at the weigh-in.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one full arcade game on any cabinet; finishing the cabinet's game, not a high score, is what the trophy asks.

steps.t: Walk up to any arcade cabinet and start its game.
Play to the game's own end screen, win or lose.
Do not walk away mid-game; quitting voids completion.
Use continues if the cabinet offers them.
Let the results screen show before leaving the cabinet.
Try a second cabinet only if the first never ends.
Completion of one full game pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission; the strand giver returns after the story, so this is watch-listed, never missable.

steps.t: Take Andy's first job when his marker appears.
Work each follow-up as Andy texts or marks them.
Keep his vehicle and cargo intact on delivery legs.
Start his strands early; one report claims story windows.
If his marker vanishes mid-story, it returns after the credits.
Accept his final mission when the strand tops out.
Completing that final mission pops the bronze.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's diving strand to its final mission; Kenton pauses after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3, a pause, not a lock.

steps.t: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 and take his first dive job.
Do not panic when his marker pauses after Chapter 1.
Resume his strand when he returns in Chapters 2-3.
Complete each dive to his stated depth and back.
Bank the underwater discoveries his dives reveal.
Take his final mission when the strand completes.
Finishing it pops the bronze; the title is a Jaws nod.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand through his final mission; ride his routes as given and the strand stays available after the story ends.

steps.t: Accept Billy's first ride when his marker appears.
Stay on his marked routes; shortcuts can void his legs.
Complete each follow-up ride as he offers them.
Start the strand when it unlocks, to be safe on windows.
Return after the story if any leg is still open.
Take Billy's final mission at the strand's end.
Completing it pops The Lone Rider bronze.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida; a strand counts only when its final mission is done, not when it is started.

steps.t: Open every stranger marker you pass; started strands stay tracked.
Finish strands one at a time so finales are not confused.
Count only completed strands in YOUR COUNT, up to 8.
The named character lines each count as one strand.
One secondary report claims windows; the fuller guide disagrees.
Post-story, all givers return, so leftovers can be mopped up.
The eighth completed strand pops the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's supply strand to its final mission; keep his deliveries intact and his strand, like the others, resumes after the story.

steps.t: Take Randy's first supply job at his marker.
Deliver each load without losing the cargo vehicle.
Follow his follow-ups as the strand escalates.
Begin the strand early in case of any story window.
Use post-story free roam to finish any open leg.
Accept Randy's final mission when offered.
Completing it pops the Supply & Demand bronze.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand through his final mission; his jobs lean on driving, so bring a car you handle well.

steps.t: Start Tyrone's strand when his marker appears.
Complete his driving jobs inside his stated conditions.
Keep the objective car repairable; totalled cars fail legs.
Open the strand on unlock, hedging the window dispute.
Finish leftover legs after the credits if needed.
Take Tyrone's final mission at the strand's end.
Completing it pops the Spin On This! bronze.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, starting with the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house, the one spot that may close when Chapter 1 ends — the run's one possible missable.

steps.t: After Down to Earth, meditate on Jason's house balcony in Chapter 1.
Do it before finishing Chapter 1; sources disagree it can wait.
Log each spot in YOUR COUNT as you clear it: 18 in total.
Sweep beach and Keys spots during the mid-story chapters.
The final spot needs duo play unlocked by Coffee Break.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are required; the trophy wants 18.
The 18th meditation pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the one unique animal Bret sends you after; take his briefing, track the animal in its stated ground, and bring the proof back to him.

steps.t: Take Bret's hunting briefing when his marker appears.
Travel to the ground Bret names for the unique animal.
Track prints and calls rather than rushing the area.
Take the animal cleanly when it finally shows.
Collect the proof the hunt asks you to carry back.
Return to Bret and hand the hunt in.
Handing it in pops the Fair Game bronze.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets from Bret's decks; a set counts only when every card in it is found, so finish decks rather than scattering pickups.

steps.t: Pick one deck and commit to finishing that set first.
Sweep each card's area slowly; cards sit off the main paths.
Log set progress in YOUR COUNT: complete sets, to 3.
Use Bret's lines; his hunts pass several card spots.
Finish set one before opening a second deck's hunt.
Complete a second and third set the same way.
The third completed set pops the silver.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 distinct locations; repeat uses at one spot do not count, so work it into every new area you enter.

steps.t: Use WAiNK It at the first location that offers the prompt.
Make it a habit: one use in every new shop and viewpoint.
Track distinct locations in YOUR COUNT toward 100.
The Keys and beach towns hold dense clusters of spots.
Revisiting a counted location adds nothing; move on.
Sweep missed districts in post-story free roam.
The 100th distinct location pops the silver.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any mix; the 100% checklist only needs 70 of 80, so this trophy's 50 arrives naturally on a completion run.

steps.t: Open the challenges list and pin the shortest ones first.
Clear driving and shooting challenges between missions.
Log completions in YOUR COUNT as you go to 50.
Timed hourglass side missions can expire; trophies do not need them.
Leave the longest grind challenges for post-story.
Mix types; no category quota hides inside the 50.
The 50th completed challenge pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape; duo play from Coffee Break onwards is the window.

steps.t: Wait until duo play is unlocked in Chapter 2.
Commit crimes together until the level reaches 4 stars.
Stay together; splitting the pair can void the attempt.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars drain.
Do not enter a safehouse while the search is active.
Let the wanted level clear fully with both partners free.
The bronze pops the moment the heat is fully lost.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping a wanted level the whole chain; plan three close shops before the first till.

steps.t: Pick a district with three shops in short driving range.
Enter shop one together and rob it with your partner present.
Drive straight to shop two without letting the stars drop.
Rob shop two and keep the chain's wanted level alive.
Repeat at shop three immediately, partner still with you.
Only after the third till, escape and lose the heat.
The bronze pops once the third robbery registers.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles by entering or scanning them as they appear in traffic; variety by district and time of day drives this counter.

steps.t: Enter every new model you see parked or in traffic.
Rotate districts; each area spawns a different vehicle pool.
Log discoveries in YOUR COUNT toward 100.
Story missions introduce several models early; use them.
Check beaches, marinas and the airport for rare spawns.
Night traffic differs from day traffic; sweep both.
The 100th distinct vehicle discovered pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation; set it up in a crowded set piece where five targets stand close before you trigger it.

steps.t: Save this attempt for a mission with grouped enemies.
Let at least five enemies gather in one sightline.
Top up health and armour before you commit.
Trigger Combat Focus once the group is set.
Work targets nearest-first so none leave the zone.
All five must fall before the Focus window ends.
The fifth takedown in one use pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, take an unscheduled departure: get airborne in a plane outside any mission or scheduled flight and leave the airport your own way.

steps.t: Travel to VCIA in free roam, outside any mission.
Reach the airfield side where planes sit parked.
Board a plane you were never scheduled to fly.
Taxi out and take off before security closes in.
Clear the airport boundary while airborne.
Stay airborne until the departure fully registers.
The bronze pops once the unscheduled departure counts.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Survive the Rhinos: when the tanks roll in at high heat, endure the encounter the description jokes about — sources are thin here, so treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed and experiment at maximum wanted level.

steps.t: Raise your wanted level until military Rhinos deploy.
Stay in the open where the tanks can engage you.
Keep moving between cover; a parked car is a target.
Survive the first full Rhino volley without dying.
Disable or evade the lead tank if the fight drags.
Escape only after the encounter has clearly registered.
Unconfirmed trigger: if nothing pops, retry at higher heat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection: enter quietly, clear the cases without an alarm or a witness call, and walk out before anyone knows.

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and watch its door traffic first.
Enter without brandishing a weapon in view.
Deal with the clerk quietly before touching the cases.
Empty the cases fast; lingering raises detection risk.
Never let a witness finish a call to the police.
Leave on foot through the door you entered by.
A clean, undetected exit pops the Sneakthief bronze.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time; vaults unlock through the cafe mission line in the story, and each vault must end in a clean escape to count.

steps.t: Unlock bank vaults through the cafe mission first.
Rob vault one and escape until the heat fully clears.
Log each escaped vault in YOUR COUNT, up to 5.
Vary districts; repeat vaults still count if they reset.
Bring your partner; vault crews move faster in pairs.
Never end a run inside the vault's search zone.
The fifth escaped vault robbery pops the silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armoured truck and escape: stop it, crack the rear doors, take the cash and lose the heat that follows.

steps.t: Find an armoured truck on its patrol route in free roam.
Block it in a low-traffic street before engaging.
Force the rear doors open once the guards are down.
Take the cash quickly; the wanted level is already rising.
Switch vehicles once to break the search pattern.
Hide until the wanted level fully clears.
A completed escape with the cash pops the bronze.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 named areas of Leonida; the map greys lift area by area, so sweep the Keys, the coast and the interior systematically.

steps.t: Open the map and note which districts are still greyed.
Drive each greyed district until its name registers.
Log areas in YOUR COUNT: 52 across the whole state.
The Leonida Keys need a boat or the causeway run.
Interior wetlands hide two easily missed areas.
Finish the sweep in post-story free roam if needed.
Registering the 52nd area pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; one robbery per gang colours its territory on this counter, repeats on one gang add nothing.

steps.t: Find an illegal operation marker in gang territory.
Rob it and escape so the robbery fully registers.
Log the gang in YOUR COUNT: 9 gangs, one hit each.
Move territory by territory across the whole map.
Story progress opens several gangs' operations.
Check the map legend to see which gangs remain.
The ninth gang's robbed operation pops the bronze.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: order the drink at the beachfront spot and take in the view the description asks for — a quiet nod to an older opening.

steps.t: Travel to Ocean Beach in free roam, on foot at the end.
Find the beachfront bar that serves cocktails.
Order a cocktail at the bar prompt.
Carry it to the open view over the beach.
Let the drink-and-view moment play fully out.
Do not sprint away; leaving early can void it.
The bronze pops as the moment completes.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom through its glass in a car, in classic style: get inside with a vehicle and leave through the window, not the door.

steps.t: Find a vehicle showroom with a street-facing glass front.
Get a car inside the showroom floor area.
Line up facing the main glass, not a side wall.
Accelerate straight through the glass in one run.
Land on the street and keep driving clear.
A door exit does not count; it must be the smash.
The bronze pops as you clear the showroom glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates alley: play at that named alley and finish your throw with the follow-through the description wants.

steps.t: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game at that alley, not any other lane.
Take your throw with a full follow-through motion.
Let the pins and scoring resolve completely.
Finish the frame rather than quitting mid-game.
The named alley matters; other alleys do not count.
The bronze pops when the follow-through registers.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A deliberately vague one: a partnership moment with mass appeal. Sources are thin and disagree, so treat this as unconfirmed — try it with your partner in a crowded public spot and log what works.

steps.t: Unlock duo play first; this is a partner trophy.
Take your partner somewhere crowded and public.
Try partner interactions where a crowd can gather.
Repeat at a second venue if the first draws no crowd.
Keep both partners present for the whole moment.
Note the exact trigger in your save notes for the run.
Unconfirmed: if it pops, it pops at the moment itself.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the run; PSN tracks this counter to 500, so ordinary play — dialogue picks, mission calls, free-roam decisions — fills most of it without a farm.

steps.t: Answer dialogue and mission choices whenever offered.
Do not skip choice prompts; each one feeds the counter.
Watch the PSN counter climb toward 500 as you play.
Story choices alone will not reach 500; side content helps.
Stranger and character strands are dense with choices.
Log progress in YOUR COUNT if you track it manually.
The 500th tracked choice pops the bronze.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail a repeatable attempt once, then pass the same attempt straight after. Sources disagree on which attempts qualify, so use a clean, quick challenge.

steps.t: Pick a short repeatable challenge you can fail safely.
Fail the first attempt deliberately and completely.
Restart the same attempt immediately, no detours.
Pass it cleanly on this second try.
Do not switch challenges between the fail and the pass.
If nothing pops, try a race restart the same way.
Unconfirmed scope: the pop lands at the second-try win.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange: Leonida's UFO moment. Coverage is thin and playful, so treat sightings as unconfirmed — be out in the wilds at night and watch the sky.

steps.t: Head into the interior wilds after dark in free roam.
Pick a clear night away from city light.
Watch the sky rather than the road for a few minutes.
Move toward any light that does not behave like a plane.
Stay until the event resolves, do not drive off early.
Repeat on another night if the first stays quiet.
Unconfirmed: the bronze pops at the sighting itself.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect with someone on foot, bowling-style.

steps.t: Equip a melee weapon you can swing from a vehicle.
Ride or drive slowly past a pedestrian on the kerb.
Time the swing as you pass, not before or after.
The hit must connect while the vehicle is moving.
A parked-vehicle swing does not count as a drive-by.
Keep speed low; too fast and the swing whiffs.
The bronze pops on the connecting drive-by hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts; feed every marked-bill payout into the laundering route instead of spending it raw.

steps.t: Unlock contacts who launder marked bills in the story.
Take jobs that pay in marked bills when offered.
Route each payout through a contact the same session.
Log the laundered total in YOUR COUNT to $250,000.
Heist payouts are the largest marked-bill sources.
Never spend marked bills raw; they must be laundered.
The bronze pops when $250,000 has been laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops combined; vehicles, clothes, weapons and services all count, so a normal completion run crosses this without trying.

steps.t: Buy weapons, armour and ammo from shops as you play.
Spend on vehicles and garages; big tickets move it fast.
Log cumulative spending in YOUR COUNT to $100,000.
Clothing and barber visits count toward the total.
Do not hoard cash early; spending is progress here.
Late-game property and car buys finish the total easily.
The bronze pops at $100,000 spent across shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map; save cash across the mid-game and sweep the property markers once your income from heists lands.

steps.t: Open the map's property layer and note all 8 garages.
Bank heist income instead of spending it all early.
Buy the cheapest garage first to start the count.
Log purchases in YOUR COUNT: 8 garages in total.
Some garages only list after story progress; revisit later.
Sweep the last listings in post-story free roam.
Buying the eighth garage pops the bronze.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: park eligible vehicles, open the app and register each one; duplicates of the same vehicle do not advance it.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app once it unlocks in Chapter 2.
Register the first eligible vehicle you park up.
Find a different vehicle for each new registration.
Log registrations in YOUR COUNT toward 10.
Story vehicles can be registered when you hold them.
Avoid re-registering a model already on the app.
The tenth registered vehicle pops the bronze.
